title: First trip to Europe with Benny Goodman in Liege
summary: Hall describes the rain and mud at a Bell Telephone concert in Belgium.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Have you toured a lot in Europe over the years?
No, that was my first trip.
Not my first trip to Europe. I went to Europe with Benny Goodman in the '60s, to Belgium, but --
Uh-huh. Was that the World's Fair?
No, this was a Bell Telephone sponsored concert in Liege --

-- 20,000 people we had, and it rained like hell the whole weekend. We had to wear boots. That's the picture that's in the jazz book with the red jacket. We all had on boots. The mud was about knee high.
That was my first experience in Europe. This last one was pretty taxing. I did more in that month in Europe than I'd done in America, as far as traveling.
